title: Mudkip
tagline: First attempt at learning about MUD's but I have no idea what I'm doing
description: I am just learning about MUD, but I don't think I will be able to make something successful in the allotted time frame. I am mostly following tutorials and trying thing to get a working project setup. This is an experiment and I will update this with more technologies as I use them.
